compatibility_default: Designed for Codex or a compatible coding-agent host with repository file access and an interactive shell. Network access is optional and owner-specific tools are never assumed.

aoa-decision.description: Find, record, or correct durable repository decisions through one decision family. Use when prior rationale, a meaningful accepted decision, supersession, or source/index drift is the task. Select exactly one internal mode and keep authored owner records authoritative. Do not use for ordinary docs edits or unresolved source-of-truth mapping.
aoa-decision.short_description: Find, record, or correct durable decisions
aoa-decision.default_prompt: Use $aoa-decision to choose exactly one find, record, or correct mode while keeping owner-authored decision records authoritative.

aoa-engineering-shape.description: Shape one software responsibility boundary through bounded-context, core-boundary, or port-adapter mode. Use when responsibilities, reusable rules, orchestration, or concrete dependencies are entangled and a small owner-aware boundary is needed before implementation. Do not use for source-authority lookup, ordinary edits, test design, or a boundary that is already clear.
aoa-engineering-shape.default_prompt: Use $aoa-engineering-shape to choose one boundary-shaping mode and return the smallest owner-aware responsibility boundary.

aoa-eval.description: Route one AoA evaluation need through select, apply, or propose mode while preserving local owner and proof-authority boundaries. Use when an existing eval/check must be found or run, or a confirmed no-fit needs an owner-local intake/design candidate. Do not use for ordinary one-off tests, undefined invariants, green-command reporting, or direct edits to central proof authority.
aoa-eval.short_description: Select, apply, or propose bounded evaluation
aoa-eval.default_prompt: Use $aoa-eval to choose exactly one select, apply, or propose mode and state the proof limit of the resulting evidence.

aoa-verification.description: Turn one stable technical truth into bounded evidence through contract, coverage-audit, or property mode. Use when a named consumer boundary, an important invariant's real coverage, or a generative system property must be made reviewable. Do not use when behavior is undefined, the task is a general test plan, or green checks are being requested as whole-system proof.
aoa-verification.short_description: Turn one stable truth into bounded evidence
aoa-verification.default_prompt: Use $aoa-verification to choose one contract, coverage-audit, or property mode, starting from manual evidence and a stable owner invariant.

aoa-knowledge-stewardship.description: Steward one knowledge boundary through authority-map, sanitized-share, or memo-route mode. Use when overlapping sources must be ranked, private technical material must become useful for a named audience, or reviewed evidence must be routed to an owner's guarded memo-candidate port. Do not use for raw session mining, direct publication, durable-memory authority, or ordinary prose editing.
aoa-knowledge-stewardship.short_description: Steward authority, sanitization, or memo routing
aoa-knowledge-stewardship.default_prompt: Use $aoa-knowledge-stewardship to choose one authority-map, sanitized-share, or memo-route mode while preserving custody and owner authority.

aoa-session-harvest.description: Convert explicitly reviewed session evidence into bounded reusable candidates through extract, classify, or branch mode. Use when a reviewed task trace contains repeatable units, an isolated unit needs its next owner/artifact route, or several continuations must remain visible. Do not use on live or unreviewed notes, for automatic promotion, or to write owner truth, quests, skills, playbooks, telemetry, or memory directly.
aoa-session-harvest.short_description: Extract and route reviewed session candidates
aoa-session-harvest.default_prompt: Use $aoa-session-harvest on explicitly reviewed evidence to choose one extract, classify, or branch mode without promoting or executing candidates.

aoa-session-recovery.description: Diagnose recurring session or workflow failure and prepare the smallest owner-routed repair through diagnose or propose-repair mode. Use when reviewed evidence shows contamination, drift, repeated tool/route failure, or a known diagnosis needs a reversible repair packet. Do not use on one live mood note, to mutate an owner directly, or to create durable validators before repeated manual evidence establishes an invariant.
aoa-session-recovery.short_description: Diagnose drift and propose reversible repair
aoa-session-recovery.default_prompt: Use $aoa-session-recovery to choose diagnose or propose-repair for reviewed recurring evidence, without mutating the target owner.
